verses.original: מַדּ֗וּעַ מִ֭שַּׁדַּי לֹא־ נִצְפְּנ֣וּ עִתִּ֑ים וְיֹדְעוֹ לֹא־ חָ֥זוּ יָמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ miš·šad·day lō- niṣ·pə·nū ‘it·tîm wə·yō·ḏə·ʿō lō- ḥā·zū yā·māw
verses.literal: Why does the Almighty not reserve times for judgment Why may those who know Him never see His days
verses.literalPt: Por que o Todo-Poderoso não designa tempos? E por que os que o conhecem não veem os dias designados?

verses.original: גְּבֻל֥וֹת יַשִּׂ֑יגוּ עֵ֥דֶר גָּ֝זְל֗וּ וַיִּרְעֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: gə·ḇu·lō·wṯ yaś·śî·ḡū ‘ê·ḏer gā·zə·lū way·yir·‘ū
verses.literal: Men move boundary stones they pasture stolen flocks
verses.literalPt: Há os que removem os limites, roubam os rebanhos e os apascentam.

verses.original: חֲמ֣וֹר יְתוֹמִ֣ים יִנְהָ֑גוּ יַ֝חְבְּל֗וּ שׁ֣וֹר אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·mō·wr yə·ṯō·w·mîm yin·hā·ḡū yaḥ·bə·lū šō·wr ’al·mā·nāh
verses.literal: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless and take the widow’s ox in pledge
verses.literalPt: Levam o jumento do órfão, tomam em penhor o boi da viúva.

verses.original: יַטּ֣וּ אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים מִדָּ֑רֶךְ יַ֥חַד חֻ֝בְּא֗וּ עֲנִיֵּי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: yaṭ·ṭū ’eḇ·yō·w·nîm mid·dā·reḵ ya·ḥaḏ ḥub·bə·’ū ‘ă·nî·yê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: They push the needy off the road and force all the poor of the land into hiding
verses.literalPt: Desviam do caminho aos necessitados; os pobres da terra juntos se escondem.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן פְּרָאִ֨ים׀ בַּֽמִּדְבָּ֗ר יָצְא֣וּ בְּ֭פָעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵ֣י לַטָּ֑רֶף עֲרָבָ֥ה ל֥וֹ לֶ֝֗חֶם לַנְּעָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hên pə·rā·’îm bam·miḏ·bār yā·ṣə·’ū bə·p̄ā·‘o·lām mə·ša·ḥă·rê laṭ·ṭā·rep̄ ‘ă·rā·ḇāh lōw le·ḥem lan·nə·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: Indeed like wild donkeys in the desert the poor go to work foraging for food the wasteland is food for their children
verses.literalPt: Como asnos monteses no deserto, saem eles ao trabalho, procurando diligentemente a comida. O ermo fornece-lhes sustento para seus filhos.

verses.original: בַּ֭שָּׂדֶה בְּלִיל֣וֹ יַקְצִירוּ וְכֶ֖רֶם רָשָׁ֣ע יְלַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: baś·śā·ḏeh bə·lî·lōw yaq·ṣī·rū wə·ḵe·rem rā·šā‘ yə·laq·qê·šū
verses.literal: They gather fodder in the fields and glean the vineyards of the wicked
verses.literalPt: No campo, cortam o seu pasto. E rabiscam na vinha do iníquo.

verses.original: עָר֣וֹם יָ֭לִינוּ מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת בַּקָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·rō·wm yā·lî·nū mib·bə·lî lə·ḇūš wə·’ên kə·sūṯ baq·qā·rāh
verses.literal: Without clothing they spend the night naked they have no covering against the cold
verses.literalPt: Passam a noite toda nus, sem roupa, e não têm com que se cobrir no frio.

verses.original: מִזֶּ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים יִרְטָ֑בוּ וּֽמִבְּלִ֥י מַ֝חְסֶ֗ה חִבְּקוּ־ צֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: miz·ze·rem hā·rîm yir·ṭā·ḇū ū·mib·bə·lî maḥ·seh ḥib·bə·qū- ṣūr
verses.literal: Drenched by mountain rains they huddle against the rocks for want of shelter
verses.literalPt: São molhados pelas chuvas dos montes e, na falta dum abrigo, achegam-se a um rochedo.

verses.original: יִ֭גְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁ֣ד יָת֑וֹם וְֽעַל־ עָנִ֥י יַחְבֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yiḡ·zə·lū miš·šōḏ yā·ṯō·wm wə·‘al- ‘ā·nî yaḥ·bō·lū
verses.literal: The fatherless infant is snatched from the breast the nursing child of the poor is seized for a debt
verses.literalPt: Há os que arrancam do peito o órfão e tomam em penhor a roupa dos pobres,

verses.original: עָר֣וֹם הִ֭לְּכוּ בְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וּ֝רְעֵבִ֗ים נָ֣שְׂאוּ עֹֽמֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·rō·wm hil·lə·ḵū bə·lî lə·ḇūš ū·rə·‘ê·ḇîm nā·śə·’ū ‘ō·mer
verses.literal: Without clothing they wander about naked They carry the sheaves but still go hungry
verses.literalPt: de modo que estes andam nus, sem roupa, e, famintos, carregam os molhos.

verses.original: בֵּין־ שׁוּרֹתָ֥ם יַצְהִ֑ירוּ יְקָבִ֥ים דָּ֝רְכ֗וּ וַיִּצְמָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bên- šū·rō·ṯām yaṣ·hî·rū yə·qā·ḇîm dā·rə·ḵū way·yiṣ·mā·’ū
verses.literal: They crush olives within their walls they tread the winepresses but go thirsty
verses.literalPt: Espremem azeite dentro das casas daqueles homens; pisam nos lagares deles e padecem sede.

verses.original: מֵ֘עִ֤יר מְתִ֨ים׀ יִנְאָ֗קוּ וְנֶֽפֶשׁ־ חֲלָלִ֥ים תְּשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וֶ֝אֱל֗וֹהַּ לֹא־ יָשִׂ֥ים תִּפְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘îr mə·ṯîm yin·’ā·qū wə·ne·p̄eš- ḥă·lā·lîm tə·šaw·wê·a‘ we·’ĕ·lō·w·ah lō- yā·śîm tip̄·lāh
verses.literal: From the city men groan and the souls of the wounded cry out yet God charges no one with wrongdoing
verses.literalPt: Da cidade levantam-se os gemidos moribundos, e clama a alma dos feridos. Contudo, Deus não o tem por loucura.

verses.original: הֵ֤מָּה׀ הָיוּ֮ בְּֽמֹרְדֵ֫י־ א֥וֹר לֹֽא־ הִכִּ֥ירוּ דְרָכָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יָ֝שְׁב֗וּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh hā·yū bə·mō·rə·ḏê- ’ō·wr lō- hik·kî·rū ḏə·rā·ḵāw wə·lō yā·šə·ḇū bin·ṯî·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Then there are those who rebel against the light not knowing its ways . . . or staying on its paths
verses.literalPt: Estes são aqueles que se rebelam contra a luz; não conhecem os caminhos dela, nem permanecem nas suas veredas.

verses.original: לָא֡וֹר יָ֘ק֤וּם רוֹצֵ֗חַ יִֽקְטָל־ עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וּ֝בַלַּ֗יְלָה יְהִ֣י כַגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lā·’ō·wr yā·qūm rō·w·ṣê·aḥ yiq·ṭāl- ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn ū·ḇal·lay·lāh yə·hî ḵag·gan·nāḇ
verses.literal: When daylight is gone the murderer rises to kill the poor and needy in the night he is like a thief
verses.literalPt: O homicida levanta-se ao romper da alva, mata ao pobre e ao necessitado e, de noite, torna-se ladrão.

verses.original: וְעֵ֤ין נֹאֵ֨ף׀ שָׁ֤מְרָֽה נֶ֣שֶׁף לֵ֭אמֹר לֹא־ תְשׁוּרֵ֣נִי עָ֑יִן וְסֵ֖תֶר פָּנִ֣ים יָשִֽׂים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ên nō·’êp̄ šā·mə·rāh ne·šep̄ lê·mōr lō- ṯə·šū·rê·nî ‘ā·yin wə·sê·ṯer pā·nîm yā·śîm
verses.literal: The eye of the adulterer watches for twilight Thinking No eye will see me he covers . . . his face
verses.literalPt: Também os olhos do adúltero aguardam o crepúsculo, dizendo: Ninguém me verá. E disfarça o seu rosto.

verses.original: חָתַ֥ר בַּחֹ֗שֶׁךְ בָּ֫תִּ֥ים יוֹמָ֥ם חִתְּמוּ־ לָ֗מוֹ לֹא־ יָ֥דְעוּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ṯar ba·ḥō·šeḵ bāt·tîm yō·w·mām ḥit·tə·mū- lā·mōw lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū ’ō·wr
verses.literal: In the dark they dig through houses by day they shut themselves in never to experience the light
verses.literalPt: De noite minam as casas; de dia, se conservam encerrados. Não conhecem a luz,

verses.original: כִּ֤י יַחְדָּ֨ו׀ בֹּ֣קֶר לָ֣מוֹ צַלְמָ֑וֶת כִּֽי־ יַ֝כִּ֗יר בַּלְה֥וֹת צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: kî yaḥ·dāw bō·qer lā·mōw ṣal·mā·weṯ kî- yak·kîr bal·hō·wṯ ṣal·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: For to them deep darkness is their morning surely they are friends with the terrors of darkness
verses.literalPt: pois a manhã é para todos eles como a sombra da morte, porque dela conhecem os pavores.

verses.original: קַֽל־ ה֤וּא׀ עַל־ פְּנֵי־ מַ֗יִם תְּקֻלַּ֣ל חֶלְקָתָ֣ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא־ יִ֝פְנֶה דֶּ֣רֶךְ כְּרָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: qal- hū ‘al- pə·nê- ma·yim tə·qul·lal ḥel·qā·ṯām bā·’ā·reṣ lō- yip̄·neh de·reḵ kə·rā·mîm
verses.literal: They are but foam on the surface of the water their portion of the land is cursed so that no one turns toward their vineyards
verses.literalPt: Passa rápido como o que é levado na superfície das águas. Maldita é a porção dos tais na terra; não anda mais pelo caminho das vinhas.

verses.original: צִיָּ֤ה גַם־ חֹ֗ם יִגְזְל֥וּ מֵֽימֵי־ שֶׁ֗לֶג שְׁא֣וֹל חָטָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣî·yāh ḡam- ḥōm yiḡ·zə·lū mê·mê- še·leḡ šə·’ō·wl ḥā·ṭā·’ū
verses.literal: As drought and heat consume the melting snow so Sheol steals those who have sinned
verses.literalPt: A sequidão e o calor desfazem as águas de neve; assim faz o Sheol aos que pecaram.

verses.original: יִשְׁכָּ֘חֵ֤הוּ רֶ֨חֶם׀ מְתָ֘ק֤וֹ רִמָּ֗ה ע֥וֹד לֹֽא־ יִזָּכֵ֑ר וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֖ר כָּעֵ֣ץ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·kā·ḥê·hū re·ḥem mə·ṯā·qōw rim·māh ‘ō·wḏ lō- yiz·zā·ḵêr wat·tiš·šā·ḇêr kā·‘êṣ ‘aw·lāh
verses.literal: The womb forgets them the worm feeds on them they are remembered no more So injustice is broken like a tree
verses.literalPt: A madre se esquecerá dele, dele se banquetearão os vermes, não será mais lembrado. Como árvore, será quebrado o injusto,

verses.original: רֹעֶ֣ה עֲ֭קָרָה לֹ֣א תֵלֵ֑ד וְ֝אַלְמָנָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְיֵטִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: rō·‘eh ‘ă·qā·rāh lō ṯê·lêḏ wə·’al·mā·nāh lō yə·yê·ṭîḇ
verses.literal: They prey on the barren and childless . . . and show no kindness to the widow
verses.literalPt: aquele que devora o estéril que não tem filhos e não faz o bem à viúva.

verses.original: וּמָשַׁ֣ךְ אַבִּירִ֣ים בְּכֹח֑וֹ יָ֝ק֗וּם וְֽלֹא־ יַאֲמִ֥ין בַּֽחַיִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·šaḵ ’ab·bî·rîm bə·ḵō·ḥōw yā·qūm wə·lō- ya·’ă·mîn ba·ḥay·yîn
verses.literal: Yet by His power God drags away the mighty though rising up they have no assurance of life
verses.literalPt: Não! Pela sua força, Deus prolonga os dias dos valentes. Ei-los de pé, quando desesperavam da vida.

verses.original: יִתֶּן־ ל֣וֹ לָ֭בֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵ֑ן וְ֝עֵינֵ֗יהוּ עַל־ דַּרְכֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yit·ten- lōw lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·yiš·šā·‘ên wə·‘ê·nê·hū ‘al- dar·ḵê·hem
verses.literal: He gives them a sense of security . . . but His eyes are on their ways
verses.literalPt: Ele lhes concede estar em segurança, e nisso se estribam. E os seus olhos estão sobre os caminhos deles.

verses.original: ר֤וֹמּוּ מְּעַ֨ט׀ וְֽאֵינֶ֗נּוּ וְֽהֻמְּכ֗וּ כַּכֹּ֥ל יִקָּפְצ֑וּן וּכְרֹ֖אשׁ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת יִמָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rō·wm·mū mə·‘aṭ wə·’ê·nen·nū wə·hum·mə·ḵū kak·kōl yiq·qā·p̄ə·ṣūn ū·ḵə·rōš šib·bō·leṯ yim·mā·lū
verses.literal: They are exalted for a moment then they are gone they are brought low and gathered up like all others they are cut off like heads of grain
verses.literalPt: São exaltados, mas, em breve tempo, se vão; são abatidos, colhidos como todos os mais, são cortados como as espigas do trigo.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֣א אֵ֭פוֹ מִ֣י יַכְזִיבֵ֑נִי וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְ֝אַ֗ל מִלָּתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ’ê·p̄ōw mî yaḵ·zî·ḇê·nî wə·yā·śêm lə·’al mil·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: If this is not so then who can prove me a liar and reduce my words to nothing
verses.literalPt: Se não é assim, quem me desmentirá e reduzirá a nada as minhas palavras?
